wayIn.name: the threshold
wayIn.what: Answer one sideways question for a suggested first world, or skip it and choose any world card yourself.

wayIn.name: the mood atlas
wayIn.gloss: how it asks, and every answer
wayIn.what: Try each question style, see the orientation it reads, and jump straight to the matching world from one place.

wayIn.name: site map
wayIn.what: Scan every page in one pass, with one plain line on what it is and what to do first.

worlds.name: the quiet room
worlds.what: Follow one breathing ring, dim the room, and set one burden down before heading onward.

worlds.name: the wish constellation
worlds.what: Read your saved sky at full scale: ask for a reading, catch meteors, play chimes, orbit it, and mint a postcard.

worlds.name: the diary
worlds.what: Turn saved stars into logbook entries, replay how they arrived, and seal capsules you can reopen later.

worlds.name: the echo chamber
worlds.what: Pulse your saved sky into drifting echoes, pick one to hear its thought, then print an echo weather bulletin.

worlds.name: the pulse choir
worlds.what: Turn saved stars into a looping choir, conduct it by tempo and muting, then print a constellation score.

worlds.name: the lantern ritual
worlds.what: Kindle your saved stars as lanterns, let them drift, and pull a ritual reading when one glow feels right.

worlds.name: the terrarium
worlds.what: Grow each saved star into a swaying plant, tap stems for their thoughts, and ask for a greenhouse forecast.

worlds.name: the weather lab
worlds.what: Map saved stars as pressure systems, launch probes into microclimates, and print a forecast from the live field.

worlds.name: the orbital weaver
worlds.what: Mirror your saved sky into a rotating mandala, tune symmetry, ripple it by touch, and print a geometry mantra.

worlds.name: the machine shop
worlds.what: Run any elementary cellular automaton rule, flip bits live, and watch tiny rule changes rewrite the whole mill.

worlds.name: the kinetic floor
worlds.what: Throw heavy blocks by pointer or keyboard, flip gravity, and turn raw momentum into a playable physics mess.

worlds.name: loam
worlds.what: Plant into soil cross-sections, water and turn the ground, and watch roots route around stone and grit.

worlds.name: the word kiln
worlds.what: Feed a word into the fire and pull out a coined term with its own fake definition and citation.

worlds.name: the apocrypha desk
worlds.what: Deal impossible specimens one by one, pin favorites to your drawer, and cross-reference strange matches.

worlds.name: the archive oracle
worlds.what: Spin your constellation through changing rune sets, archive omens, and forge a downloadable sigil.

edges.name: lost in space
edges.what: If a link misses, you still land in a playable station with a radio, decoder, scope, and clear routes back in.

edges.name: sitemap.xml
edges.what: Get the same page list in XML, with relative paths so the site works under any publish path.
